name: AIChipMemory
description: An inline label for remembered context: using-memory, previous-context, memory-available, memory-ignored, memory-removed.
intent: Tell the user when the system is drawing on something it learned earlier.

props.name: variant
props.hint: Required. Declared in the component source.

props.name: label
props.hint: Required. Declared in the component source.

props.name: size
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

variants.name: using-memory
variants.when: Actively drawing on it now. Signal tint, because the user should notice.

variants.name: previous-context
variants.when: Carried from earlier in the session. Neutral.

variants.name: memory-available
variants.when: Could be used, currently is not.

notes: The sr-only prefix supplies the variant meaning, so the icon and tint are never the only signal.
memory-removed uses line-through, which is not announced by screen readers — the prefix carries it instead.

usage: When a response depends on remembered context
To show what memory is available but unused
To confirm that memory was ignored or removed
doNotUse: When no memory is in play
As a general tag — use ui:badge
To imply memory the system does not actually have
Implying memory that does not exist

agentRules: Only render when memory is genuinely involved.
Forgetting should be as visible as remembering — do not silently drop the removed and ignored variants.
